newsitem.title: USA: Delta picks finalists for ad account.
newsitem.headline: Delta picks finalists for ad account.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc said it has narrowed the list of finalists for its $100 million advertising account to four agencies, Cordiant Plc's Saatchi & Saatchi, Interpublic Group of Cos Inc's Ammirati Puris Lintas, Omnicom Group Inc's BBDO and WPP Group Plc's Ogilvy & Mather.
A total of 10 agencies were invited to pitch the account.
Failing to make the final four was Leo Burnett, which had hoped to snare another major airline after losing its long-time client, UAL Corp unit United Airlines, last year.
United and Delta both went up for review after a combined 75 plus years at their respective agencies of record. Delta was with BBDO for 51 years.
The finalists will make presentations at the end of February and a final selection will be announced in March, Delta said.
